results.name: Motu Patlu
results.overview: Inspired by the characters of Lot Pot Comics, Motu Patlu is a lively comic caper for the kids as well as the entire family. Set in the beautiful city of Furfuri Nagariya, the story is about Motu and Patlu, who are as similar as chalk and cheese. The Awesome Twosome are always on an adventurous expedition and have an uncanny ability to get into tricky situations every single day! It was premiered on 16 October 2012, beginning with the episode "John Banega Don". It focuses on two friends, Motu and Patlu, living in the fictional city Furfuri Nagar.

known_for.title: The Price of Milk
known_for.overview: Lucinda lives a fairytale life with dairy farmer Rob, and his 117 cows. But after a freak car accident she decides to test Rob's love for her by trying to make him angry. He passes her tests until a quilt goes missing from their bed and the price of getting it back is high.

known_for.title: Janibek Alimkhanuly vs. Andrei Mikhailovich
known_for.overview: Undefeated New Zealand contender Andrei Mikhilovich seeks to create history against Kazakhstan’s middleweight king Janibek “Qazaq Style” Alimkhanuly for the IBF world title at The Star in Sydney, NSW, Australia.

known_for.title: Dalton Smith vs. Walid Ouizza
known_for.overview: Dalton Smith faces Walid Ouizza for the European and WBC silver super lightweight titles at Nottingham’s Motorpoint Arena.

known_for.name: Celebrity Treasure Island
known_for.overview: Kiwi stars face off in paradise for the chance to win money for their chosen charities. With eliminations each week until the final celebrities remain, it will be a treasure hunt to end all treasure hunts!

known_for.title: The City of Lost Children
known_for.overview: A scientist in a surrealist society kidnaps children to steal their dreams, hoping that they slow his aging process.

known_for.title: Gramps Is in the Resistance
known_for.overview: It is 1943 in Paris. Like so many others, the Bourbelle family's home has been taken over by the Germans and they now live in their cellar. Little do they know that the son, Guy-Hubert Bourdelle, is far from being the cowardly hairdresser he pretends. He is in truth the Germans’ most feared opponent: le super-résistant!

known_for.title: For Those I Loved
known_for.original_title: Au nom de tous les miens
known_for.overview: Polish Martin Gray recalls the Holocaust, New York prosperity, and losing his wife and family.

known_for.title: A Small Life
known_for.overview: A tragic portrait of mother and child exploring grief through music and lyrical imagery.

results.title: Motu Patlu in Wonderland
results.overview: When pals Motu and Patlu take a ride in their scientist friend's newly built plane, a crash-landing on a strange island leads to action and adventure.

results.title: Motu Patlu: Mission Moon
results.overview: An otherworldly enemy has been turning the moon's soil into gold for his own greedy interests! Can friends Motu and Patlu stop him?

results.title: Motu Patlu in Octopus World
results.overview: While returning a goldfish and an octopus from an aquarium to the sea, Motu and Patlu must also save the goldfish's family from a mean, tentacled queen.

results.title: Motu Patlu & Robo Kids
results.overview: For Motu, facing off against three children becomes an unexpected challenge when he realizes they have superstrength -- and a secret!

results.title: Motu Patlu Dino Invasion
results.overview: A time machine sends Motu and Patlu back to the dinosaur period, but the real trouble starts when the reptiles travel back to the present day with them!

results.title: Motu Patlu: Deep Sea Adventure
results.overview: Friends Motu and Patlu get more maritime excitement than anticipated when the sinking of their ship sends them on a journey through the ocean floor!

results.title: Motu Maeva
results.overview: A portrait of Sonja, adventurer of the twentieth century, living on an island that she built by herself: Motu Maeva.

results.title: De Motu
results.overview: "De Motu", a short film on 60 meters of 16mm made for the Filmmaker Festival Walking Cinema project.

results.title: Motu Patlu: Kung Fu Kings
results.overview: Tiger Chang, a martial arts master from a village located in the Himalayas, visits Furfuri Nagar. After defeating the boxers in a boxing competition, he insults the people of Furfuri Nagar. To restore the prestige of Furfuri Nagar, Motu decides to learn martial arts and defeat Tiger Chang. Can Motu overcome Tiger Chang's challenge and restore the pride of Furfuri Nagar? Watch to find out!

results.title: Motu Patlu: King of Kings
results.overview: Motu and Patlu are your home-grown Laurel and Hardy in an animation avatar. They befriend a circus lion, Guddu and attempt to save the jungle from a greedy poacher.

results.title: Motu Patlu 36 Hours Race Against Time
results.original_title: Motu Patlu 36 Ghantey Race Against Time
results.overview: Motu and Patlu aim to find the stolen trophy in the shape of a golden car before finishing a race. During their journey, they overcome several obstacles and help expose the thief.

results.title: Motu Patlu & The Race to the Diamond Valley
results.original_title: Motu Patlu & The Race to the Diamond Valley
results.overview: Motu and Patlu decide to participate in the race to help their village's development. Soon after, they land in France, where they face off against talented racers from various parts of the world. Will they emerge victorious?

results.title: Motu Patlu: Khazaane Ki Race
results.overview: To find a treasure that could help their city thrive, Motu and Patlu must thwart a don and his henchman, who want the wealth for themselves!

results.title: Motu Patlu in the Game of Zones
results.original_title: Motu Patlu in the Game of Zones
results.overview: A board game becomes all too real for buddies Motu and Patlu when they get transported into its world of monsters, magic and mayhem.

results.title: Lies in Motion
results.overview: A contemplation on the deceit of vision, visual systems, and mediums.
